windows_checkout_policy.operator_message: On Windows, reuse or create exactly one canonical checkout under the user's Desktop\dev folder. Do not invent -latest siblings, derive a checkout from the downloaded launcher directory, or keep persistent browser-proof website copies in arbitrary Temp folders.

modes.operator_message: Open the public AFK Agent Flow surface directly. Do not require Git, ZIP extraction, PowerShell, Python, or Termux for normal use.
Open the phone launcher in the system browser, then use the install or Add to Home Screen surface.

Use the repository-owned CMD. It owns safe clone or fast-forward behavior, resolves the single canonical Desktop\dev checkout independently of where the CMD was downloaded, and serves the validated portable Prompt Kit on the stable loopback origin.

android_prerequisites: Install Termux from F-Droid when a real Android shell checkout is required.
modes.operator_message: Use a real checkout only when the user intends to edit, commit, push, inspect source locally, or run repository tooling. On Windows the default checkout is Desktop\dev\web-excel-repair-triage. Before updating an existing checkout, prove canonical origin, a clean worktree, current branch main, and zero local-only commits; then fast-forward main only.
Treat ZIP as a point-in-time snapshot. It is not the preferred normal-use or Favorites-preserving update path.

data_plane_architecture.invariant: GitHub contains product truth; static hosting contains public distributable truth; a user's device contains personal truth. No private user state belongs in GitHub or the public Pages bundle.

may_store: public schemas, validators and eval definitions
must_never_receive: private sync vault or recovery identifiers
persistent device, browser, installation or analytics identifiers
personal favorites, collections, annotations or raw usage history
private project, repository, file path or customer context
raw user, agent or clipboard content from usage

egress: allowlisted Sync Capsule encrypted before user-selected transport

may_store_outside_device: non-secret public envelope version and cryptographic algorithm metadata
must_never_receive_plaintext: project, repository or file path context
user identity, account identity or persistent device identity
encryption keys, recovery material or pairing secrets

may_store: allowlisted aggregate prompt behavior fields from PrivacyReducer
must_never_receive: user, account, installation, device, browser, vault or persistent pseudonymous identifiers
session, conversation, trace or correlation identifiers
project, repository, branch, customer, URL or file path context
raw user, prompt, agent, feedback, error or clipboard text

repository_authority.role: source, governance, validation and build factory

github_pages.publication_rule: A file may be published only when anonymous worldwide download is acceptable.
must_never_publish: local journal or raw usage history
vault, session, device or user identifiers
encryption keys, recovery phrases or pairing secrets

user_device.role: only plaintext authority for personal use data

logical_stores.public_cache: re-creatable Prompt Canon and static assets
logical_stores.personal_state: favorites, collections, saved variants, preferences, tags and explicitly saved notes/workflows
logical_stores.local_journal: raw usage, execution, correction, project and task context; never automatically synchronized
logical_stores.privacy_reducer_buffer: local reduced aggregates awaiting threshold or export
logical_stores.sync_state: last local capsule/base and encrypted portable save metadata
logical_stores.secrets: encryption/recovery material in platform-protected storage where available

forbidden_pre_encryption: raw user requests or agent responses
repository, project, customer, branch, URL or file path context
session, conversation, trace or correlation identifiers
persistent user, account, installation, browser, device or vault identifiers
encryption keys, recovery phrases or pairing secrets
transport_policy: The encrypted artifact may be copied through user-selected storage such as OneDrive, Google Drive, iCloud, Dropbox, Syncthing, NAS, USB or ordinary file transfer.
Prompt Kit v1 does not require a Prompt Kit-owned sync server or cloud account.
A future automatic transport must preserve this capsule boundary rather than expanding it to raw local history.

privacy_reducer_contract.input_authority: device-local personal state and local journal
invariants: Forbidden values may not be hashed, encoded, encrypted or renamed into correlation fields.
Equivalent allowed behavior with different identity, project, device and session context must reduce to identical collective evidence.
The reducer may write only a local aggregate buffer; a separate uploader is required for any future network transport.

conversation_repository_promotion_contra.purpose: Govern the one-way graduation of conversation-derived working context into shared Prompt Kit repository truth without publishing user-specific learning, reasoning, identity, or other personal state.
governing_invariants: Conversation and device-local state may inform repository decisions but do not become repository truth merely because they were useful.
Only repository-specific conclusions that can stand independently of the person who supplied them are eligible for shared repository promotion.
When any promotion gate is failed or unknown, keep the material private/local or in ephemeral working state rather than committing it.

examples: what the user knows or does not know
mistakes, uncertainty, confidence, preferences and learning progress
raw user messages, dialogue and reasoning history
personal identity, profile, contact or unrelated life context
draft wording that still depends on the originating dialogue

repository_candidate.requirement: A repository-specific, impersonal conclusion has been derived but is not canonical until every promotion gate passes and the smallest repository owner accepts it.

repository_truth.requirement: The promoted artifact is repository-specific, impersonal, evidence-bound, privacy-safe, discoverable to downstream consumers, and no longer depends on the originating conversation.

transformation: derive the repository-relevant conclusion from the conversation
remove user identity, learning state, confidence, mistakes, reasoning history and irrelevant personal context
rewrite the result as repository-level behavior, requirement, decision, invariant, interface, acceptance gate, unresolved project question or sanitized evidence
reconcile the candidate against current canonical repository/provider/runtime authority
write only the minimum durable form to the smallest canonical owner

allowed: unresolved repository questions with owner and blocking status
repository evidence or proof receipts that contain no forbidden personal context
rejected or superseded technical alternatives only when needed to prevent material rediscovery
forbidden: raw user messages or conversation transcripts
learning records, quiz results, mistakes or mastery history
knowledge gaps, uncertainty or confidence assessments
personal reasoning history or hidden chain-of-thought
personal preferences that are not themselves repository requirements
user identity, profile, contact or account data
health, career, financial, relationship or other unrelated personal context
credentials, secrets, recovery material or private tokens
session, conversation, trace or persistent user/device identifiers
private customer, organization or project context that is not authorized public repository truth

provenance_policy.rule: Record the decision/evidence class when provenance matters; do not name or profile the person merely because they supplied the input.

conversation_repository_promotion_contra.consumer_test: A competent contributor who knows nothing about the originating user must be able to understand, implement, test, operate or maintain the promoted artifact without needing the private conversation.

examples.private_input: I do not really understand leases, but I want ownership to expire eventually.
examples.repository_output: Sprint ownership uses an expiring lease with an explicit renewal rule.

examples.private_input: I am worried agents will stomp on one another because this has happened to me repeatedly.
examples.repository_output: Concurrent sprint ownership is rejected unless an explicit ownership-transfer rule succeeds.

examples.private_input: I failed this concept twice and am only about 60% confident.

guardrails: Do not tell a normal phone or browser user to clone the repository merely to use the Prompt Kit.
Do not tell a mobile GitHub-app user to hunt for or download web/prompt-kit/index.html as the primary access path.
Distinguish use/install intent from edit/commit/push intent before prescribing acquisition commands.

On Windows, automatic acquisition must reuse or create Desktop\dev\web-excel-repair-triage and must fail closed if that canonical path cannot be used; do not create -latest sibling checkouts or derive a checkout from the launcher download directory.

Do not leave persistent local browser-proof copies of the Prompt Kit under arbitrary Temp or download directories; use the canonical checkout, repository-owned Outputs, or CI-owned ephemeral runner storage.

For existing editable checkouts, verify canonical origin, clean worktree, current branch main, and zero local-only commits before fetching and fast-forwarding; never reset, clean, force-push, or discard local work.
Do not claim Add to Home Screen, PWA installation, Termux, Git authentication, browser storage, or clipboard behavior succeeded without device observation.
Resolve the canonical website through this contract and harness/artifacts.v1.json instead of guessing an index.html path.
Do not put plaintext personal state, local journals, raw prompt history, recovery material, or PrivacyReducer buffers in the repository or GitHub Pages bundle.
Do not require a Prompt Kit-owned backend for v1 private state portability; encrypted save transport remains user-selected.

Do not commit raw Socratic dialogue, user learning state, uncertainty, reasoning history or personal context merely because it influenced a repository decision; promote only the impersonal repository conclusion through conversation_repository_promotion_contract.
proof_ceiling: Repository/static architecture and contract proof only. This contract defines and validates ownership boundaries, current GitHub Pages bundle mapping, local-only data classes, portable encrypted-save requirements, and PrivacyReducer output/batching policy. It does not prove browser IndexedDB/local persistence, encryption implementation, .pkenc export/import runtime, cross-device pairing, hosted sync, network anonymity, Collective Learning ingestion, or physical device behavior. It also proves the declared conversation-to-repository graduation states, all-of promotion gate, repository-worthy artifact allowlist, and forbidden personal-state classes; it does not prove an agent runtime actually applied the gate to a live conversation.
